Tmdb._comment: Never set ApiKey here. Use `dotnet user-secrets set Tmdb:ApiKey <key>` locally, or the Tmdb__ApiKey app setting in Azure.

PlayerTokens._comment: Left blank on purpose — HmacPlayerTokenService falls back to a documented local-dev key when unset. Use `dotnet user-secrets set PlayerTokens:SigningKey <key>` locally, or the PlayerTokens__SigningKey app setting in Azure, for anything beyond local testing.
